edges.reason: transfer forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value)
msg.sender is passed as the _from argument of the internal transferFrom call
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the caller the privileged account
constructor writes owner, defining the privileged address used by all owner checks
constructor sets totalSupply from the _supply argument
constructor mints balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply without SafeMath
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall
delegate reaches the arbitrary delegatecall primitive on the caller-supplied address
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before batch transfers
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication
batchSend subtracts total from balanceOf[msg.sender] without SafeMath
batchSend reads and rewrites balanceOf entries for sender and recipients
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] with a raw unchecked subtraction
the allowance mapping entry is the storage slot mutated by the unchecked subtraction
transferFrom reads and writes allowance entries to authorise spending
transferFrom reads and mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value
transferFrom is guarded by the ensure modifier restricting sender/recipient identities
ensure calls pairFor to derive the allowed Uniswap pair address
ensure compares _from/_to against the owner state variable
ensure embeds the constant UNI router address in the comparison logic
_to parameter flows into the transfer recipient argument
_value parameter flows into the transfer amount argument
_from parameter controls the source balance and allowance entries
_to parameter controls the destination balance entry
_value parameter controls the transferred amount in transferFrom
_spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping in approve
_value parameter is stored as the approved allowance amount
address a parameter is used as the delegatecall target in delegate
bytes b parameter is supplied directly as delegatecall calldata
_tos array parameter drives the batchSend loop recipients
_value parameter is the per-recipient amount in batchSend
transferFrom _value is subtracted from the allowance entry unchecked
batchSend _value is multiplied by the recipient array length unchecked
_tos.length multiplies _value in the unchecked total computation
local total is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender] without SafeMath
loop index i controls iteration of the batchSend recipient loop
local _to derived from _tos[i] is credited in balanceOf
local UNI pair address is compared against _from inside ensure
